meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: Claude会帮你完成旧版NanoClaw到新版v2的迁移收尾：先检查迁移进度文件，再设置你的管理员身份、迁移聊天记忆、核对容器配置，并处理你改动过的自定义代码。它会先确保新版能正常收发消息，再继续。
howto.when: 当你提到“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”、“v1 migration”时触发。它会先确认迁移脚本已运行，再开始收尾工作。

say.note: 会开始检查迁移状态并收尾

say.text: 帮我设置新版本的所有者
say.note: 会引导你确认身份并授予owner权限
会运行记忆迁移，保留历史上下文

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through finishing a NanoClaw v1→v2 migration: verifies the handoff, sets up the owner, migrates old memory, fixes container configs, and helps port custom code. It tests that v2 handles messages before moving on.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'migrate from v1', 'finish migration', or 'v1 migration'. It first checks that the migration script has run before proceeding.

say_en.text: Let's continue migrating from v1 to v2.
Set me as the owner of the new version.
say_en.note: Confirms identity and grants owner role.

say_en.text: Migrate my old chat history to v2.
say_en.note: Runs memory migration for preserved context.
